text:
Alex: :wave: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated version bump across api, runtime, console, and sdk for next week. Thinking cutoff = Thu 18:00 PT. Can teams confirm blockers?
Maria: Agree on cutoff, but need changelog entries from each repo by Wed EOD. I can collect.
Jin: Any breaking changes expected from runtime? If so we should flag in the API and SDK PRs.
Alex: Jin — nothing major in runtime from my side, just a small kv-cache param rename documented in the runtime changelog. Not breaking semver but will call it out.
Sam: CI note: when you bump runtime version, please update the integration matrix in .github/workflows/compat.yml — I can add a check if folks want.
Tara: For console: can we do a canary rollout for the UI changes tied to the version bump? Suggest 10% for 2 hours then 50% if green.
Leo: If someone needs a hotfix lane, we should reserve a branch cutoff at Tue 23:59 PT so infra can prep quickpatches.
Maria: Changelog template — please paste one-liners like: "runtime: document kv-cache param rename (non-breaking)". I'll assemble into the release notes.
Alex: Tagging @release-bot to create the meta-PR once we have all PRs merged.
release-bot: Release PR preflight created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-meta/pull/482 — includes api@v2.14.0, runtime@0.9.6, console@1.4.2, sdk-js@3.0.1.
Jin: Quick ask — any pinned transitive deps we should bump in SDKs? I found one: axios 0.27 -> 1.0 may need tests.
Sam: For the merge window: recommend opening PRs today, request reviews, and use `bors-ng` or merge queue to avoid flakes. Also please run `./scripts/regenerate-openapi.sh` for API changes.
Tara: Console will queue a canary PR by tomorrow morning. I'll include rollout JSON and a healthcheck endpoint: `/health/release`.
Leo: Ops note: we'll pre-allocate a small Dedicated slab for smoke tests Friday morning 08:00 PT. Ping ops once PRs are merged.
Alex: Action items: 1) All teams add changelog one-liners by Wed EOD (Maria collates). 2) Open PRs today and request reviews. 3) Reserve hotfix branch by Tue 23:59 PT (Leo). 4) Console canary plan (Tara). 5) Sam to ensure CI matrix updated. Anyone object?
Maria: :thumbsup: no objections.
Jin: LGTM — I'll add a note in runtime PR about the kv-cache rename and compatibility tests.
Sam: I'll drop a small CI job to fail fast on dep bumps.
Tara: I'll post canary run results in this thread when ready.
Alex: Thanks all — tagging again: @Maria @Jin @Sam @Tara @Leo. If anyone hits a blocker, DM me or ping here.
Maria: One more: please add `CHANGELOG.md` entries in the repo root (not only PR description) so the release-bot picks them up.
Alex: Good call.
release-bot: CI checks: api: ✅, runtime: ⏳, console: ✅, sdk-js: ✅ — runtime CI queued.
Jin: Runtime CI passed now. Marking ready.
Alex: Closing the loop: cutoff Thu 18:00 PT unless something critical pops up. We'll do the meta-PR merge Fri 09:00 PT after canary verification.
Tara: Canary ran, no regressions, posting logs: https://logs.internal.redwood/canary/482
Leo: Ops smoke tests green. Prep for merge.
Alex: Great work, folks. I'll ship the meta-PR tomorrow morning. :shipit:
